Fortress Dark Oak Anti-Slip Decking Stain provides robust protection and a rich finish for outdoor timber decking. This water-based, quick-drying stain is formulated to enhance the durability of wood, making it ideal for garden decking, patios, and walkways. Its advanced water and UV-resistant properties safeguard surfaces from harsh weather and sun damage, while the integrated anti-slip characteristic improves safety for all foot traffic. Applied easily by brush or roller, the stain is touch-dry in two hours and recoatable in four, allowing for efficient project completion. A 2.5 litre tub covers up to 25 square metres, ensuring excellent coverage for professional decking maintenance.
